records.description: La majorité des CV n'atteignent jamais un recruteur : ils sont filtrés par un logiciel ATS avant même d'être lus. CVPocket génère des CV pensés pour ces filtres, permet d'adapter chaque candidature à une offre précise en un clic, et suit automatiquement où en est chaque candidature envoyée.

records.name: Lumora Lens
records.tagline: Social media on autopilot for busy small businesses
records.description: Lumora Lens learns a small business, turns approved offers, services, photos, and customer questions into a monthly content plan, prepares branded posts and captions, organizes review, and schedules approved work. Plans add supervised routine reply support, possible-lead alerts, qualification context, and owner handoff while sensitive customer decisions stay with the business.

records.name: OppPilot
records.tagline: Find your next SEO growth opportunity with AI
records.description: Turn Google Search Console data into SEO growth. Discover opportunities, prioritize your Worklist, execute with AI, and measure results — all in one workflow.

records.name: AI Act Fix Kit
records.tagline: Free 1-min checker: does EU AI Act Article 50 apply to you?
records.description: The EU AI Act's Article 50 rules are enforceable Aug 2, 2026. Free 1-minute check: does it apply to you? Unlock the exact fix, not an 80-page kit.

records.name: ROAS Copilot
records.tagline: True ROAS from real sales across Google, Meta & TikTok
records.description: Platform ROAS often looks better than reality. ROAS Copilot combines Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok spend with real sales so agencies see True ROAS. Find wasted budget, review search terms, run AI campaign analysis, generate ad copy with approve-before-push, send scheduled client reports, and manage SEO all in per-client workspaces. Free for dashboard & True ROAS; Pro adds AI, automation, and multi-account work.

records.name: Glowmetra
records.tagline: AI-Powered dermatology
records.description: Glowmetra — AI-powered personalized skincare companion. Decode and understand your skin with clinical-grade analysis in seconds.

records.name: TempChats
records.tagline: Temporary Ephemeral Anonymous
records.description: Create secure temporary chat rooms that automatically expire. No account required. Fast, private and free.

records.name: Telegram
records.tagline: Your AI Bitcoin guide to learn, understand and use Bitcoin.
records.description: You can contact @BitcoinAsistentBot right away.

records.name: GPAA News
records.tagline: GPA - sarkari yojana 2026
records.description: best yojana jobs

records.name: Lumeni — A native macOS task manager
records.tagline: Brings clarity to your projects
records.description: Lumeni is a native macOS task manager built for the Tahoe era. Three-pane workflow, Quick Entry, Calendar import, and Liquid Glass design.

records.name: Cal Clear
records.tagline: Scheduling that checks all your calendars. Zero tracking.
records.description: Cal Clear: free scheduling app that checks all your Google Calendars — no double booking, no tracking. Best free Calendly alternative 2026.

records.name: Axon
records.tagline: AI Agentic Admin UI System
records.description: Design intelligent AI products faster

records.name: Twinle
records.tagline: One QR scan. Every profile. No more app-switching.
records.description: Meeting someone new usually means asking for their Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, X, or LinkedIn separately, then hunting through apps to find the right profile. Twinle fixes this with one QR scan that instantly opens your selected profiles and contact info — no typing, no searching, no wrong matches. What's different: a true all-in-one digital identity, not just another business card. You control what's visible with privacy settings, and sharing works instantly on any device, no install needed.

records.name: Drive Mad Unblocked
records.tagline: Play Drive Mad unblocked—free, no downloads or ads!
records.description: Play Drive Mad unblocked at school for free. No download, no block, no ads interruption. Drive Mad online works on Chromebook & school WiFi. Click and play now!

records.name: IELTS Spelling Master
records.tagline: Audio Dictation Trainer
records.description: IELTS Spelling Master is a lightning-fast, open-source audio dictation web application built specifically to help IELTS candidates eliminate careless spelling errors in the IELTS Listening test.

records.name: run402
records.tagline: The full stack an AI agent can spin up and pay for
records.description: run402 is a full-stack platform (Postgres, auth, storage, functions, frontend hosting) an AI agent can provision, deploy, and pay for on its own: per call via x402 or MPP, or card credits as its allowance. Atomic deploys, hard spend caps, structured errors. Open source.

records.name: GriffNode
records.tagline: Non-custodial crypto payments, straight to your wallet
records.description: Accept BTC, ETH, LTC, DOGE, DASH and stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI) with zero KYC. Funds go straight to your wallet: no chargebacks, instant settlement.

records.name: Companion Intelligence App Store
records.tagline: made-easy private and personal cloud
records.description: Companion Hub — Companion Intelligence App Store. Browse self-hosted apps and open-source alternatives without signing in; sign in for library, devices, and organizations.

records.name: TableMenu
records.tagline: Digital (QR) menu, seamless reservations, table ordering
records.description: All-in-one digital restaurant management solution offering QR code menu, QR code ordering, reservations, AI-powered content generation, and an intuitive admin dashboard.

records.name: SnapMerge
records.tagline: Merge group photos into one perfect shot
records.description: Upload 2 to 3 similar group photos and let SnapMerge create one natural AI best take with better faces, open eyes, and cleaner group expressions.

records.name: ParkRight
records.tagline: AI-powered vehicle verification for office parking
records.description: ParkRight helps organisations instantly verify whether a vehicle belongs on their premises. Security teams can scan a number plate or search manually to identify employee vehicles, reducing unauthorised parking and time spent on manual verification. Built for offices, business parks, factories, and other workplaces, ParkRight makes parking verification faster, simpler, and more reliable.

records.name: Whorl
records.tagline: A generative design tool. No AI. Lots of play.
records.description: Generative design tool for mesmerizing visuals, still and in motion. Posters for events, brand and presentation assets, music-video loops, conference identities, etc. All from play: make something unique in seconds, or spend hours creating. Runs in your browser on desktop or tablet.

records.name: Name 100 Women Challenge
records.tagline: A clean, blazing-fast version of the viral Twitch challenge.
records.description: The viral "Name 100 Women" challenge turned into a distraction-free web app. Zero ads, zero clunkiness, and smart name validation. Just you and the timer.

records.name: AI Stock Metadata Generator
records.tagline: AI-powered metadata generator for stock photographers
records.description: Generate optimized titles, descriptions, and keywords for your stock photos in seconds. Built for Adobe Stock, Shutterstock, Getty/iStock, Freepik, Dreamstime, and Vecteezy — just upload your image and get platform-ready metadata powered by AI. Runs entirely in your browser, no installation needed. Free to use.

records.name: MayIA° - Smart dataLayer monitoring
records.tagline: The AI agent that QAs your dataLayer
records.description: MayIA, your Agent that checks your dataLayer before and after each deployment, detects tracking regressions in real time, and automatically adapts as the site changes.

records.name: PRNotch
records.tagline: GitHub pull requests in your Mac's notch
records.description: PRNotch puts your GitHub pull requests in your Mac's notch review queue, CI state, and alerts in a native menu bar app. No telemetry. $1 once.

records.name: KanaBlob
records.tagline: Learn and review Japanese Hiragana & Katakana
records.description: Free, no ads, no microtransactions. Master the basics of the Japanese language with KanaBlob! Designed to be minimalist and immersive, this app lets you learn, review, and test your knowledge of Japanese syllabary (Hiragana and Katakana). No ads, no bad surprises. Track your progress alongside Blob and start your Japanese journey today. The original LOFI soundtrack will keep you perfectly focused and in the zone. Perfect for absolute beginners or anyone looking to review in a chill mode!

records.name: AssentRepo
records.tagline: Dev-first DPDP & GDPR consent banner engine and more
records.description: India's DPDP Act ready. Drop-in consent banner + DSAR queue for Shopify, WordPress and SaaS. Avoid the ₹250 crore penalty. GDPR & CCPA included.

records.name: Nexus Historia
records.tagline: Build Your Own Alternate-History Timeline
records.description: Nexus Historia is an interactive alternate-history sandbox where players, students, teachers and history fans explore branching timelines, storyboards and AI-driven scenarios. Also play 'The House of Unsaid Things' for free.

records.name: Defaulter List-For Agencies Across World
records.tagline: Know who you're dealing with before you get burned
records.description: Defaulter List is a community registry where agency owners report clients and businesses who default on payments. Search a name, company or location before you take the work.

records.name: AfriCallShop
records.tagline: Cheap international calls & airtimes to Africa and worldwide
records.description: Call your family in Africa and worldwide at the best per-minute rate, and send mobile top-ups in seconds with AfriCallShop on iOS and Android.

records.name: Gridova
records.tagline: [Windows] 100% offline desktop workspace & document builder
records.description: A 100% offline Windows desktop workspace for organizing structured data, building documents, and tracking workflows—no login, subscriptions, or cloud servers. Features dynamic tables/forms, invoice & PDF generation, encrypted streaming backup, interactive relationship maps, and Git-style Excel diff/merge. Safely delivered via the Microsoft Store sandbox with a 1-time purchase.

records.name: Worker Builder
records.tagline: AI Shopify Theme Builder
records.description: WORKER, yapay zeka ile saniyeler içinde profesyonel Shopify temaları oluşturur. Tek bir prompt yazın, çoklu sayfa Shopify OS 2.0 temanızı mağazanıza tek tıkla kurun. Kodlama gerekmez.

records.name: ShipDR
records.tagline: Maker-Proven Backlink Engine
records.description: Track your Domain Rating free, then submit and track backlinks on maker-proven startup directories. Every listing verified: live, dofollow, indexed, still there. $10 once per website, no subscription.

records.name: Life Planner & AI OPERATING SYSTEME
records.tagline: The Dream Life Planner & AI Life Operating System
records.description: ✨ Build The Life You've Always Dreamed Of — Powered By Your Personal AI Assistant.Do you ever feel like your vision is crystal clear in your mind… but your daily routine just can't keep up?You start Monday with high energy. You write down your goals....
